notes: Radial mode: one top-down view rotated at runtime toward the velocity vector.
The sprite's front points to the top of the frame; rotation is atan2(vy,vx)+90 degrees.
Geometry was normalized by scripts/normalize_radial.py, not requested from the image generator, which ignores numeric geometry instructions.
Recolorido de carmesim para verde-jade por rotacao de matiz para 150 graus, preservando saturacao e valor: a grama e 85 graus, entao a separacao e por matiz.
Frames a 256 px para que o runtime reduza em vez de ampliar (RenderScale 0.575 = 147 px em tela).
